The Modern Azure Journey: Where Data Meets AI (Data → Intelligence → Experience) Extending Existing Azure Databricks Investments with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake & Microsoft Foundry — Zero Data Duplication
ACT 1 — 1/3 DATA Meet Customers Where Their Data Lives — Zero-Copy Interoperability Without Forced Migration
